verdict.rationale: Railway documents a chat-based Railway Agent built into the dashboard that operates the platform on the user's behalf: it creates and configures services, inspects deployments, diagnoses failures and opens fix PRs. The same agent can be used from Slack via @Railway, and an MCP server plus Agent Skills let external AI assistants drive Railway through natural language. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language operation works as documented, since all evidence is first-party.
